title: Google breaks promise to provide 10 years of updates to Chromebooks
summary: Google has broken its promise to provide 10 years of automatic software updates to Chromebooks, a commitment that was a major selling point for these devices. This policy change affects consumers who purchased Chromebooks based on this extended support promise.
problem_solved: No problem solved; this is a news article reporting on Google's broken promise regarding Chromebook update policies.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about corporate commitments and consumer rights in the tech industry.
